caption: The drawing depicts a puppet-like figure positioned centrally against a plain, off-white background. The figure has a rounded head with a light brown color and short, brown hair. The facial features include large, blue eyes, a prominent nose, red lips, and blush-like pink accents on the cheeks. The figure's body is covered with a loose-fitting, draped garment that is predominantly green, varying in shade from lighter to darker areas, suggesting folds and shadows. Each arm extends outward, ending in mitten-shaped hands colored brown, while the wrists have pink cuffs. The overall composition is simple, with no additional objects or background details, and the figure appears to be floating or standing alone on the page.
title: Hand Puppet Boxer
